spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(s.order_value), 0) AS value
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}';

SELECT
    r.return_reason,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_value
FROM returns_events r
JOIN products p
    ON r.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN sales_events s
    ON r.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE r.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY r.return_reason
ORDER BY refund_value DESC;

SELECT
    s.region,
    ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_value

FROM returns_events r

JOIN sales_events s
    ON s.order_id = r.order_id

JOIN products p
    ON p.product_id = s.product_id

WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'

GROUP BY s.region

ORDER BY refund_value DESC;

WITH unique_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.order_id,
        s.product_id,
        s.region,
        s.sales_channel,
        s.quantity
    FROM sales_events s
    JOIN products p
        ON s.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
      AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
      AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
    GROUP BY
        s.order_id,
        s.product_id,
        s.region,
        s.sales_channel,
        s.quantity
),

unique_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        r.product_id,
        r.region,
        r.quantity_returned
    FROM returns_events r
    JOIN products p
        ON r.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE r.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
      AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM sales_events s
          WHERE s.order_id = r.order_id
            AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
      )
    GROUP BY
        r.order_id,
        r.product_id,
        r.region,
        r.quantity_returned
),

sales_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(s.quantity) AS sold_qty
    FROM unique_sales s
    JOIN products p
        ON s.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.category
),

returns_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_qty
    FROM unique_returns r
    JOIN products p
        ON r.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.category
)

SELECT
    s.category,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0)
        / NULLIF(s.sold_qty, 0),
        2
    ) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sales_by_category s
LEFT JOIN returns_by_category r
    ON s.category = r.category
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;

SELECT
    s.sales_channel,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_value

FROM returns_events r

JOIN products p
    ON r.product_id = p.product_id

JOIN sales_events s
    ON r.order_id = s.order_id

WHERE r.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'

GROUP BY s.sales_channel

ORDER BY refund_value DESC;

SELECT
    p.product_name,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units
FROM returns_events r
JOIN products p
    ON r.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN sales_events s
    ON r.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE r.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY returned_units DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Average Order Value
spec.description: average amount spent per order for the selected region, category, and sales channel.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(s.order_value), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}';

spec.title: Customer Segment Average Order Value
spec.description: Shows which customer segments tend to place higher-value orders.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    c.customer_segment,
    ROUND(AVG(s.order_value), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM sales_events s
JOIN customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY c.customer_segment
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;

spec.title: Top 10 Products by Revenue
spec.description: Identifies the products contributing the most revenue, helping managers focus inventory and promotions on important products.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    p.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(s.order_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}';

spec.title: Payment Method Revenue Mix
spec.description: Shows how much revenue comes through each payment method.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    s.payment_method,
    ROUND(SUM(s.order_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY s.payment_method
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

spec.title: Discount Strategy by Category
spec.description: Helps compare discounting against revenue, order value and units sold rather than looking at discount percentage alone.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(AVG(s.discount_pct), 2) AS avg_discount_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(s.order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    ROUND(SUM(s.order_value), 2) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(s.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(s.streamed_at, '1m'),
    MAX(s.order_value) AS max_order_value
FROM sales_events s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.streamed_at)
  AND s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM products p
      WHERE p.product_id = s.product_id
        AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  )
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(s.order_value) / NULLIF(SUM(s.quantity), 0),
        0
    ) AS revenue_per_unit
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}';

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN s.order_value < 2000 THEN 'Under ₹2K'
        WHEN s.order_value < 5000 THEN '₹2K–₹5K'
        WHEN s.order_value < 10000 THEN '₹5K–₹10K'
        WHEN s.order_value < 20000 THEN '₹10K–₹20K'
        ELSE 'Above ₹20K'
    END AS order_value_band,
    SUM(s.order_value) AS revenue
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN s.order_value < 2000 THEN 'Under ₹2K'
        WHEN s.order_value < 5000 THEN '₹2K–₹5K'
        WHEN s.order_value < 10000 THEN '₹5K–₹10K'
        WHEN s.order_value < 20000 THEN '₹10K–₹20K'
        ELSE 'Above ₹20K'
    END
ORDER BY MIN(s.order_value);

SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(s.order_value) AS revenue
FROM sales_events s
JOIN products p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.inventory_status,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM inventory_events i
JOIN products p
    ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN stores st
    ON i.store_id = st.store_id
WHERE st.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sales_events s
      WHERE s.product_id = i.product_id
        AND s.store_id = i.store_id
        AND s.region = st.region
        AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY i.inventory_status
ORDER BY event_count DESC;

spec.title: Average stock remaining above/below the reorder level

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(
        AVG(i.stock_after - i.reorder_level),
        2
    ) AS stock_cushion
FROM inventory_events i
JOIN products p
    ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN stores st
    ON i.store_id = st.store_id
WHERE st.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sales_events s
      WHERE s.product_id = i.product_id
        AND s.store_id = i.store_id
        AND s.region = st.region
        AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY stock_cushion ASC;

SELECT
    ca.device_type,
    ROUND(AVG(ca.duration_seconds), 2) AS avg_duration_seconds
FROM customer_activity ca
JOIN products p
    ON ca.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ca.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sales_events s
      WHERE s.product_id = ca.product_id
        AND s.store_id = ca.store_id
        AND s.region = ca.region
        AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY ca.device_type
ORDER BY avg_duration_seconds DESC;

SELECT
    ca.activity_type,
    COUNT(*) AS activity_count
FROM customer_activity ca
JOIN products p
    ON ca.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ca.region REGEXP '${region:regex}'
  AND p.category REGEXP '${category:regex}'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sales_events s
      WHERE s.product_id = ca.product_id
        AND s.store_id = ca.store_id
        AND s.region = ca.region
        AND s.sales_channel REGEXP '${channel:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY ca.activity_type
ORDER BY activity_count DESC;
